cc:Work.dc:title: Does cutting Roundup change MN9?
cc:Work.dc:description: Saved exploratory simulations: five paired input seeds at each of three recurrent gains. Teal circles show intact counts; orange squares show Roundup outgoing-weight cuts. Each connector joins one input seed. Seeds are inputs, not animals; no biological validation or significance is claimed.
